#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string st;
    std::getline(std::cin, st);
    
    // First block
    char p = st[0];
    st = st.substr(1);
    // Replace all "dot" with "."
    size_t pos = 0;
    while ((pos = st.find("dot", pos)) != std::string::npos) {
        st.replace(pos, 3, ".");
        pos += 1;
    }
    st = p + st;
    if (!st.empty() && st.back() == '.') {
        st.pop_back();
        st += "dot";
    }
    
    // Second block
    p = st[0];
    st = st.substr(1);
    // Replace first occurrence of "at" with "@"
    size_t at_pos = st.find("at");
    if (at_pos != std::string::npos) {
        st.replace(at_pos, 2, "@");
    }
    st = p + st;
    if (!st.empty() && st.back() == '@') {
        st.pop_back();
        st += "at";
    }
    
    std::cout << p + st << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
